verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no setting for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. The closest item is an enterprise-only option, arranged through an account manager, to keep organization data out of AI model training. That is an adjacent data-use control, not a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
